bsdd.name: any other bSDD-published dictionary (the uri pins which)

notes: Classification is the core's ONE kind mechanism (rule E4): what an element, a spatial container, a group or a catalog type IS comes from external, versioned dictionaries, never from a schema enum or a core token. This registry governs only the INSTANCE NAMES (aeco:class:<system>:...) so that two tools naming the same dictionary use the same token; the codes, names and URIs inside an instance belong to the dictionary's publisher. Consumers WARN, never error, on an instance name outside this list. `ifc` is the recommended default system because every authoring tool can emit an IFC entity name; its code form is '<Entity>' or '<Entity>.<PREDEFINEDTYPE>'. The registry is separate from the schema; a project profile may name additional systems.
